description: Convert any web page into clean, readable Markdown. Fetches a public web page and returns clean Markdown: title, byline, site name, excerpt, word count and article body. Respects robots.txt, blocks private hosts, follows up to five redirects, caps the page at 3 MB. links=true adds outbound links. Not charged on failure: 403 if robots.txt disallows the path, 415 for non-HTML, 422 if no article text extracts, 502 on upstream error. Costs $0.003 USDC per call (x402).
name: read_url_as_markdown
